description.en: Starts work on a project: a value map before any question (who it is for, what they get, how we know), a preview of the stack, the tests and the memory it already has, the infra profile, the owner's working style and risk, then a recap with next steps and the roadmap skeleton.
description.ru: Начинает работу над проектом: карта ценности до любых вопросов (для кого, что получают, как узнаем), обзор стека, тестов и уже накопленной памяти, профиль инфраструктуры, стиль работы владельца и риск, затем итог со следующими шагами и каркасом дорожной карты.

ru: Разберись в проекте с нуля и предложи план
Подготовь старт: стек, тесты, память, инфраструктура
en: Start work on a new project
Get to know the project from scratch and propose a plan
Prepare the start: stack, tests, memory, infra

nodes.prompt: Value map builder, before asking anything: from README, the passport (project-onboard), the site and the code — who the product is for, the job they hire it for, what they get, how we would know it works. Write .agents/planning/VALUE-MAP.md.

Stack and tests: languages, frameworks, the test command and whether it is green. Memory preview: lane_pilot_memory context (what the hub corpus already knows), the memory graph of notes by area. Infra profile: hosts, start, deploy, logs into lane-plan profile --set (the one profile writer).
Working style and risk from the owner's anamnesis. Recap in five lines, three next steps, and the roadmap skeleton (lane-plan template fill ROADMAP, STATE; phases with lane-plan phase add).
